desc:
Team up with friends and move furniture together... what could go wrong? 🛋️💥

🆕 UPDATE: RELAXED & ENDLESS MODE! Pick your mode when you start a move 🎉
☕ Relaxed: no quotas, no bankruptcy, move at your own pace
♾️ Endless (unlocks after beating Classic): no finish line! How many days can your crew survive?
📦 Classic: the story: pay back the shady boss and buy the warehouse

💼 You took a loan from a VERY shady boss. Hit your daily quota... or lose everything.

🚚 HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a job and drive the truck to the house
• Carry couches, fridges, beds and pianos together!
• Load the truck without breaking anything
• Put every piece in its spot in the new house
• Earn cash: break less, earn more!

🛒 Mover's Mart: crazy gadgets like balloons, portal guns and shrink rays 🎈🌀
💾 Runs save for a whole week: continue anytime!
👥 Friend Bonus: +10% pay when you play with friends
⭐ Level up, unlock new classes and forever upgrades
🧤 Collect gloves
